issues.type: C6 빈칸추론 정답 본문 노출 가능
issues.note: 빈칸 'By the end of World War I in 1918, the empire was __________ and, by the time I was born in 1950, it was a memory.' 정답 ② 'fatally wounded'. 본문 자체에 'the empire was fatally wounded'가 있고 빈칸이 같은 자리. ① never set / ③ presided over / ④ laughed out 모두 본문 다른 곳 표현 — 학생이 본문 어디서 가져올지 패턴으로 풀 수 있음.

wa 'was the crucible of the Industrial Revolution and its military forces secured the colonies as surely as the English language invaded their cultures' — ei.fullPassage 'Britain was the crucible of the Industrial Revolution and its military forces secured the colonies as surely as the English language invaded their cultures'에 그대로 있음. 23단어 영작이지만 사실상 베껴쓰기. accept 1개만 → NORM이 처리해도 변별력 0.
④ 'would have been laughing' 오류 — '비웃음당하다' 수동 변별. ①②③은 명백한 정상 표현. 어려움 6점 문항인데 ④만 보고 단번에 답 가능.
wa 'colonies' 1단어. accept ['colonies', 'the colonies']. 'secured' 동사 단서로 자명. 보통 5점.
passage 빈칸 'the largest empire in history: ___', 주어진 단어 [empire/over/which/never/on/the/set/sun] — 본문 그대로 'the empire on which the sun never set'. 영작 변별력 0.
